task_description: Perform an exhaustive manual QA audit of the Budget Tracker web app (Next.js 16 / React 19 / Supabase / Gemini) that lives on origin/feature/budget-tracker (commit d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b), and produce a full QA report (QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md) covering all 9 deliverable sections: QA Summary, Bug Report Table, Detailed Bug Reports, UX Suggestions, Security Findings, Accessibility Findings, Performance Findings, Production Readiness Score (0-100), and Final Recommendation. Live-test everything runnable without external credentials; code-review everything gated behind missing Supabase/Gemini keys and mark it Blocked (not passed/failed). main is only a stock create-next-app starter, so the feature branch is the real audit target.

verification.summary: npm run build compiles with 0 type errors (13 routes); npm run lint passes with 0 errors and 1 documented warning (raw in scan page). No automated test suite exists (this is an audit-only task; the deliverable is QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md). Report contains all 9 required sections in order, states audited branch feature/budget-tracker @ d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b, uses the exact bug-table columns, gives a 34/100 score and a 'Needs Major Fixes' recommendation, and contains 0 em dashes. Finding-quality verified by spot-checking BUG-002 (CSV string concat at transactions/page.tsx:62), BUG-003 (no auth check in parse-receipt route), BUG-004 (deleteAccount only deletes profiles row + signOut, no admin.deleteUser), and BUG-011 (startsWith path matching) directly against the source: all confirmed present and accurately described. No Docker present, so docker_build skipped. REVIEW-FIX PASS (2026-08-27-134220-review.md, verdict APPROVED): addressed all 5 review points against source - (1) trimmed BUG-015 threat description to internal-path-only redirection since app/auth/callback/route.ts interpolates `${origin}${next}` (protocol-relative escapes resolve same-origin), keeping the allow-list fix; (2) added distinct BUG-017 (Medium/P2) for the `if (!user) return;` early-return firing after setLoading(true)/setStep('saving')/setSaving(true) in transactions/new handleSubmit, scan handleSave, and settings saveProfile, permanently disabling the button / stranding the spinner - added table row, full detailed report, and bumped Failed 8->9 and tests 68->69; (3) noted BUG-009 `npm audit fix --force` pulls next@16.3.3 (outside stated range) as a breaking upgrade needing build/lint re-verification; (4) added Section 4 UX note on budgets totalSpent (all monthly expenses) vs totalBudget (defined budgets only) conflation; (5) budgets em-dash source copy is informational only and no em dashes introduced into the report. Re-verified: 9 sections present, exact bug-table columns intact, valid 'Needs Major Fixes' recommendation, 0 em dashes.
